title: Algebraic Fractions
seo_title: Algebraic Fractions – SSS 2 Mathematics Worksheets with Answers (NERDC)
standard_text: Simplify algebraic fractions; multiply, divide, add and subtract algebraic fractions; solve equations with algebraic fractions. (summary of the NERDC SSS 2 Mathematics curriculum)
meta_desc: Free SSS 2 maths worksheets on algebraic fractions: simplifying by factorising, multiplying and dividing, adding and subtracting, and equations. 100 questions with answers.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • Factorise the top and bottom, then cancel common factors.
  • To divide, multiply by the reciprocal of the second fraction.
  • To add or subtract, use a common denominator.

Examples

Example

(x² − 9) ÷ (x + 3)

(x − 3)(x + 3) ÷ (x + 3)

Answer: x − 3

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Cancelling terms: (x + 3)/3 = xOnly factors cancel.
Not using a common denominator1/x + 1/y = (y + x)/xy.
Forgetting the values that make the bottom 0The fraction is undefined there.

faq.q: How do I solve an equation with fractions?
faq.a: Multiply both sides by the LCM of the denominators.

items.q: Simplify 10x²12x.
items.e: Divide the numbers by their HCF and subtract the powers of x: 5x6.

items.q: Simplify 5x²12x.
items.e: Divide the numbers by their HCF and subtract the powers of x: 5x12.

items.q: Simplify x² − 1x + 1.
items.e: x² − 1 = (x + 1)(x − 1). Cancel the common factor: x − 1.

items.q: Simplify x² − 64x + 8.
items.e: x² − 64 = (x + 8)(x − 8). Cancel the common factor: x − 8.

items.q: Simplify x² − 81x + 9.
items.e: x² − 81 = (x + 9)(x − 9). Cancel the common factor: x − 9.

items.q: Simplify 5x12x².
items.e: Divide the numbers by their HCF and subtract the powers of x: 512x.

items.q: Simplify x² − 7x + 12x − 3.
items.e: Factorise the top: (x − 3)(x − 4). Cancel (x − 3): x − 4.

items.q: Simplify 6x²5x³.
items.e: Divide the numbers by their HCF and subtract the powers of x: 65x.

items.q: Simplify 12x7x³.
items.e: Divide the numbers by their HCF and subtract the powers of x: 127x².

items.q: Simplify 10x7x.
items.e: Divide the numbers by their HCF and subtract the powers of x: 107.

items.q: Simplify 3x + 35x + 5.
items.e: Factorise: 3(x + 1) ÷ 5(x + 1). The bracket (x + 1) cancels, leaving 35.

items.q: Simplify 5x − 157x − 21.
items.e: Factorise: 5(x − 3) ÷ 7(x − 3). The bracket (x − 3) cancels, leaving 57.

items.q: Simplify x² + 11x + 28x² − x − 20.
items.e: Factor: (x + 4)(x + 7)(x + 4)(x − 5). Cancel the common factor (x + 4): x + 7x − 5, with x ≠ −4, 5. (You cannot cancel the x² terms.)

items.q: Simplify x² − 7x + 10x² − 3x + 2.
items.e: Factor: (x − 2)(x − 5)(x − 2)(x − 1). Cancel the common factor (x − 2): x − 5x − 1, with x ≠ 2, 1. (You cannot cancel the x² terms.)

items.q: What values of x are excluded from the domain of x² − 16x² + 7x + 12?
items.e: Factor the denominator: (x + 4)(x + 3). It is 0 at both values, even though (x + 4) cancels with the numerator. x = −4 and x = −3.

items.q: Simplify x² − 3x − 10x² + 8x + 12.
items.e: Factor: (x + 2)(x − 5)(x + 2)(x + 6). Cancel the common factor (x + 2): x − 5x + 6, with x ≠ −2, −6. (You cannot cancel the x² terms.)

items.q: Simplify x² + 2x − 24x² + 3x − 28.
items.e: Factor: (x − 4)(x + 6)(x − 4)(x + 7). Cancel the common factor (x − 4): x + 6x + 7, with x ≠ 4, −7. (You cannot cancel the x² terms.)

items.q: Simplify x² + 2x − 35x² + x − 30.
items.e: Factor: (x − 5)(x + 7)(x − 5)(x + 6). Cancel the common factor (x − 5): x + 7x + 6, with x ≠ 5, −6. (You cannot cancel the x² terms.)

items.q: Simplify x² − 36x² + 3x − 18.
items.e: Factor: (x + 6)(x − 6)(x + 6)(x − 3). Cancel the common factor (x + 6): x − 6x − 3, with x ≠ −6, 3. (You cannot cancel the x² terms.)

items.q: Simplify x² − 7x + 6x² − 3x − 18.
items.e: Factor: (x − 6)(x − 1)(x − 6)(x + 3). Cancel the common factor (x − 6): x − 1x + 3, with x ≠ 6, −3. (You cannot cancel the x² terms.)

items.q: Simplify 5x³7 × 32x.
items.e: Multiply tops and bottoms, then cancel: 15x³14x. 15x²14.

items.q: Simplify 5x²8 ÷ 9x2.
items.e: Dividing is multiplying by the reciprocal: 5x²8 × 29x = 5x36.

items.q: Simplify 5x²7 ÷ 8x³5.
items.e: Dividing is multiplying by the reciprocal: 5x²7 × 58x³ = 2556x.

items.q: Simplify 3x³8 × 85x.
items.e: Multiply tops and bottoms, then cancel: 24x³40x. 3x²5.

items.q: Simplify 9x³2 ÷ 4x³5.
items.e: Dividing is multiplying by the reciprocal: 9x³2 × 54x³ = 458.

items.q: Simplify 3x2 ÷ 7x³4.
items.e: Dividing is multiplying by the reciprocal: 3x2 × 47x³ = 67x².

items.q: Simplify 4x³5 ÷ 7x³3.
items.e: Dividing is multiplying by the reciprocal: 4x³5 × 37x³ = 1235.

items.q: Simplify 6x5 × 72x².
items.e: Multiply tops and bottoms, then cancel: 42x10x². 215x.

items.q: Simplify 5x2 × 35x.
items.e: Multiply tops and bottoms, then cancel: 15x10x. 32.

items.q: Simplify 5x³8 ÷ 7x²5.
items.e: Dividing is multiplying by the reciprocal: 5x³8 × 57x² = 25x56.

items.q: Simplify 4x³9 × 45x³.
items.e: Multiply tops and bottoms, then cancel: 16x³45x³. 1645.

items.q: Simplify 3x³5 × 57x².
items.e: Multiply tops and bottoms, then cancel: 15x³35x². 3x7.

items.q: Simplify x² + 4x + 3x² + 3x − 4 · x − 1x + 3.
items.e: Factor: (x + 3)(x + 1)(x − 1)(x + 4) · x − 1x + 3. Cancel (x + 3) and (x − 1): x + 1x + 4.

items.q: Simplify x² + 5x + 6x² + 13x + 42 · x + 7x + 2.
items.e: Factor: (x + 2)(x + 3)(x + 7)(x + 6) · x + 7x + 2. Cancel (x + 2) and (x + 7): x + 3x + 6.

items.q: Simplify x² − 10x + 21x + 5 ÷ x² − 4x − 21x + 5.
items.e: Multiply by the reciprocal: (x − 7)(x − 3)x + 5 · x + 5(x − 7)(x + 3). Factor and cancel (x − 7) and (x + 5): x − 3x + 3.

items.q: Simplify x² − 5x − 6x − 4 ÷ x² − 1x − 4.
items.e: Multiply by the reciprocal: (x + 1)(x − 6)x − 4 · x − 4(x + 1)(x − 1). Factor and cancel (x + 1) and (x − 4): x − 6x − 1.

items.q: Simplify x² + 6x + 5x² + 3x − 28 · x − 4x + 1.
items.e: Factor: (x + 1)(x + 5)(x − 4)(x + 7) · x − 4x + 1. Cancel (x + 1) and (x − 4): x + 5x + 7.

items.q: Simplify x² + 13x + 42x² − 1 · x − 1x + 7.
items.e: Factor: (x + 7)(x + 6)(x − 1)(x + 1) · x − 1x + 7. Cancel (x + 7) and (x − 1): x + 6x + 1.

items.q: Simplify x² − 5x + 6x + 4 ÷ x² − 9x + 14x + 4.
items.e: Multiply by the reciprocal: (x − 2)(x − 3)x + 4 · x + 4(x − 2)(x − 7). Factor and cancel (x − 2) and (x + 4): x − 3x − 7.

items.q: Simplify x² + 8x + 12x + 5 ÷ x² + 5x + 6x + 5.
items.e: Multiply by the reciprocal: (x + 2)(x + 6)x + 5 · x + 5(x + 2)(x + 3). Factor and cancel (x + 2) and (x + 5): x + 6x + 3.

items.q: Simplify x − 24 − x + 12.
items.e: Use the common denominator 4: (x − 2)4 − 2(x + 1)4 = −x − 44. Multiply every term in the second bracket by −1.

items.q: Simplify x − 34 + x + 45.
items.e: Use the common denominator 20: 5(x − 3)20 + 4(x + 4)20 = 9x + 120.

items.q: Simplify x + 15 − x + 54.
items.e: Use the common denominator 20: 4(x + 1)20 − 5(x + 5)20 = −x − 2120. Multiply every term in the second bracket by −1.

items.q: Simplify x + 13 + x + 14.
items.e: Use the common denominator 12: 4(x + 1)12 + 3(x + 1)12 = 7x + 712.

items.q: Simplify x5 − x + 42.
items.e: Use the common denominator 10: 2(x)10 − 5(x + 4)10 = −3x − 2010. Multiply every term in the second bracket by −1.

items.q: Simplify x + 63 + x − 44.
items.e: Use the common denominator 12: 4(x + 6)12 + 3(x − 4)12 = 7x + 1212.

items.q: Simplify x − 13 − x + 32.
items.e: Use the common denominator 6: 2(x − 1)6 − 3(x + 3)6 = −x − 116. Multiply every term in the second bracket by −1.

items.q: Simplify x + 52 + x − 25.
items.e: Use the common denominator 10: 5(x + 5)10 + 2(x − 2)10 = 7x + 2110.

items.q: Simplify x − 35 − x − 54.
items.e: Use the common denominator 20: 4(x − 3)20 − 5(x − 5)20 = −x + 1320. Multiply every term in the second bracket by −1.

items.q: Simplify x + 23 − x + 65.
items.e: Use the common denominator 15: 5(x + 2)15 − 3(x + 6)15 = 2x − 815. Multiply every term in the second bracket by −1.

items.q: Simplify x3 − x + 22.
items.e: Use the common denominator 6: 2(x)6 − 3(x + 2)6 = −x − 66. Multiply every term in the second bracket by −1.

items.q: Simplify x − 55 − x − 53.
items.e: Use the common denominator 15: 3(x − 5)15 − 5(x − 5)15 = −2x + 1015. Multiply every term in the second bracket by −1.

items.q: Simplify 4x + 2 + 2x + 4.
items.e: LCD = (x + 2)(x + 4). Rewrite: 4(x + 4)(x + 2)(x + 4) + 2(x + 2)(x + 2)(x + 4). Combine the numerators: 4(x + 4) + 2(x + 2) = 6x + 20. 6x + 20(x + 2)(x + 4).

items.q: Simplify 2x + 1 − 6x − 6.
items.e: LCD = (x + 1)(x − 6). Rewrite: 2(x − 6)(x + 1)(x − 6) − 6(x + 1)(x + 1)(x − 6). Combine the numerators: 2(x − 6) − 6(x + 1) = −4x − 18. −4x − 18(x + 1)(x − 6).

items.q: Simplify 2xx + 7 + 7xx + 7.
items.e: The denominators match, so combine the numerators and keep the denominator: 9xx + 7. Never add the denominators.

items.q: Simplify 5x − 1 − 2x + 4.
items.e: LCD = (x − 1)(x + 4). Rewrite: 5(x + 4)(x − 1)(x + 4) − 2(x − 1)(x − 1)(x + 4). Combine the numerators: 5(x + 4) − 2(x − 1) = 3x + 22. 3x + 22(x − 1)(x + 4).

items.q: Simplify 8xx + 5 − 7xx + 5.
items.e: The denominators match, so combine the numerators and keep the denominator: xx + 5. Never add the denominators.

items.q: Simplify xx + 7 + 7xx + 7.
items.e: The denominators match, so combine the numerators and keep the denominator: 8xx + 7. Never add the denominators.

items.q: Simplify 2x + 2 − 6x + 7.
items.e: LCD = (x + 2)(x + 7). Rewrite: 2(x + 7)(x + 2)(x + 7) − 6(x + 2)(x + 2)(x + 7). Combine the numerators: 2(x + 7) − 6(x + 2) = −4x + 2. −4x + 2(x + 2)(x + 7).

items.q: Simplify 4xx + 7 − 2xx + 7.
items.e: The denominators match, so combine the numerators and keep the denominator: 2xx + 7. Never add the denominators.

items.q: Simplify 2x − 1 + 1x − 2.
items.e: Common denominator (x − 1)(x − 2): 2(x − 2)(x − 1)(x − 2) + 1(x − 1)(x − 1)(x − 2) = 3x − 5(x − 1)(x − 2).

items.q: Simplify 3x − 1x − 2.
items.e: Common denominator x(x − 2): 3(x − 2)x(x − 2) − 1xx(x − 2) = 2x − 6x(x − 2).

items.q: Simplify 1x − 1 + 3x − 2.
items.e: Common denominator (x − 1)(x − 2): 1(x − 2)(x − 1)(x − 2) + 3(x − 1)(x − 1)(x − 2) = 4x − 5(x − 1)(x − 2).

items.q: Simplify 1x − 2 + 5x + 1.
items.e: Common denominator (x − 2)(x + 1): 1(x + 1)(x − 2)(x + 1) + 5(x − 2)(x − 2)(x + 1) = 6x − 9(x − 2)(x + 1).

items.q: Simplify 5x − 1 + 4x + 2.
items.e: Common denominator (x − 1)(x + 2): 5(x + 2)(x − 1)(x + 2) + 4(x − 1)(x − 1)(x + 2) = 9x + 6(x − 1)(x + 2).

items.q: Simplify 1x + 1x − 1.
items.e: Common denominator x(x − 1): 1(x − 1)x(x − 1) + 1xx(x − 1) = 2x − 1x(x − 1).

items.q: Simplify 5x − 1 + 4x − 3.
items.e: Common denominator (x − 1)(x − 3): 5(x − 3)(x − 1)(x − 3) + 4(x − 1)(x − 1)(x − 3) = 9x − 19(x − 1)(x − 3).

items.q: Simplify 4x − 2 + 5x + 2.
items.e: Common denominator (x − 2)(x + 2): 4(x + 2)(x − 2)(x + 2) + 5(x − 2)(x − 2)(x + 2) = 9x − 2(x − 2)(x + 2).

items.q: Simplify 2x − 2 − 2x + 2.
items.e: Common denominator (x − 2)(x + 2): 2(x + 2)(x − 2)(x + 2) − 2(x − 2)(x − 2)(x + 2) = 8(x − 2)(x + 2).

items.q: Simplify 1x − 3 + 5x − 1.
items.e: Common denominator (x − 3)(x − 1): 1(x − 1)(x − 3)(x − 1) + 5(x − 3)(x − 3)(x − 1) = 6x − 16(x − 3)(x − 1).

items.q: Simplify 2x − 4x − 1.
items.e: Common denominator x(x − 1): 2(x − 1)x(x − 1) − 4xx(x − 1) = −2x − 2x(x − 1).

items.q: Simplify 2x − 2 − 5x + 3.
items.e: Common denominator (x − 2)(x + 3): 2(x + 3)(x − 2)(x + 3) − 5(x − 2)(x − 2)(x + 3) = −3x + 16(x − 2)(x + 3).

items.q: Simplify 4x − 2 + 4x.
items.e: Common denominator x(x − 2): 4xx(x − 2) + 4(x − 2)x(x − 2) = 8x − 8x(x − 2).

items.q: Simplify 2x − 5x + 2.
items.e: Common denominator x(x + 2): 2(x + 2)x(x + 2) − 5xx(x + 2) = −3x + 4x(x + 2).

items.q: Simplify 4x − 1 − 4x + 2.
items.e: Common denominator (x − 1)(x + 2): 4(x + 2)(x − 1)(x + 2) − 4(x − 1)(x − 1)(x + 2) = 12(x − 1)(x + 2).

items.q: Simplify 2x + 3 − 5x + 2.
items.e: Common denominator (x + 3)(x + 2): 2(x + 2)(x + 3)(x + 2) − 5(x + 3)(x + 3)(x + 2) = −3x − 11(x + 3)(x + 2).

items.q: Simplify 5x + 1 + 5x − 1.
items.e: Common denominator (x + 1)(x − 1): 5(x − 1)(x + 1)(x − 1) + 5(x + 1)(x + 1)(x − 1) = 10x(x + 1)(x − 1).

items.q: Simplify 3x − 1 − 1x − 3.
items.e: Common denominator (x − 1)(x − 3): 3(x − 3)(x − 1)(x − 3) − 1(x − 1)(x − 1)(x − 3) = 2x − 8(x − 1)(x − 3).

items.q: Simplify 4x − 1x − 2.
items.e: Common denominator x(x − 2): 4(x − 2)x(x − 2) − 1xx(x − 2) = 3x − 8x(x − 2).

items.q: Simplify 4x − 3 − 5x + 3.
items.e: Common denominator (x − 3)(x + 3): 4(x + 3)(x − 3)(x + 3) − 5(x − 3)(x − 3)(x + 3) = −x + 27(x − 3)(x + 3).

items.q: Simplify xx² − 49 + 1x + 7.
items.e: x² − 49 = (x + 7)(x − 7). Write the second fraction as x − 7(x + 7)(x − 7). Add the tops: x + x − 7 = 2x − 7 over the common denominator.

items.q: Simplify xx² − 9 + 1x + 3.
items.e: x² − 9 = (x + 3)(x − 3). Write the second fraction as x − 3(x + 3)(x − 3). Add the tops: x + x − 3 = 2x − 3 over the common denominator.

items.q: Simplify x² − 163x + 15 × x + 5x − 4.
items.e: Factorise: x² − 16 = (x + 4)(x − 4) and 3x + 15 = 3(x + 5). Cancel (x − 4) and (x + 5): x + 43.

items.q: Simplify x² − 92x − 10 × x − 5x − 3.
items.e: Factorise: x² − 9 = (x + 3)(x − 3) and 2x − 10 = 2(x − 5). Cancel (x − 3) and (x − 5): x + 32.

items.q: Yusuf drives 40 km at x km/h and then 90 km at (x + 5) km/h. Which expression gives the total time in hours?
items.e: Time = distance ÷ speed: 40x + 90x + 5 = 40(x + 5) + 90xx(x + 5) = 130x + 200x(x + 5).

items.q: A student writes x + 3x + 9 = 13. What is the mistake?
c: The answer should be 39
x and 3 are terms, not factors, so they cannot be cancelled
items.e: Only common factors cancel. x + 3 and x + 9 have no common factor, so the fraction cannot be simplified. x and 3 are terms, not factors, so they cannot be cancelled.

items.q: Nonso drives 60 km at x km/h and then 90 km at (x + 5) km/h. Which expression gives the total time in hours?
items.e: Time = distance ÷ speed: 60x + 90x + 5 = 60(x + 5) + 90xx(x + 5) = 150x + 300x(x + 5).

items.q: Simplify x² − 13x − 12 × x − 4x − 1.
items.e: Factorise: x² − 1 = (x + 1)(x − 1) and 3x − 12 = 3(x − 4). Cancel (x − 1) and (x − 4): x + 13.

items.q: Babatunde drives 120 km at x km/h and then 60 km at (x + 15) km/h. Which expression gives the total time in hours?
items.e: Time = distance ÷ speed: 120x + 60x + 15 = 120(x + 15) + 60xx(x + 15) = 180x + 1,800x(x + 15).

items.q: Simplify x² − 362x + 4 × x + 2x − 6.
items.e: Factorise: x² − 36 = (x + 6)(x − 6) and 2x + 4 = 2(x + 2). Cancel (x − 6) and (x + 2): x + 62.

items.q: Simplify x² − 45x + 25 × x + 5x − 2.
items.e: Factorise: x² − 4 = (x + 2)(x − 2) and 5x + 25 = 5(x + 5). Cancel (x − 2) and (x + 5): x + 25.

items.q: Uche drives 20 km at x km/h and then 60 km at (x + 5) km/h. Which expression gives the total time in hours?
items.e: Time = distance ÷ speed: 20x + 60x + 5 = 20(x + 5) + 60xx(x + 5) = 80x + 100x(x + 5).

items.q: Kayode drives 40 km at x km/h and then 90 km at (x + 5) km/h. Which expression gives the total time in hours?
items.e: Time = distance ÷ speed: 40x + 90x + 5 = 40(x + 5) + 90xx(x + 5) = 130x + 200x(x + 5).

items.q: Yusuf drives 90 km at x km/h and then 120 km at (x + 5) km/h. Which expression gives the total time in hours?
items.e: Time = distance ÷ speed: 90x + 120x + 5 = 90(x + 5) + 120xx(x + 5) = 210x + 450x(x + 5).

items.q: Simplify 1 + 4523 − 12.
items.e: Top: 1 + 45 = 95. Bottom: 23 − 12 = 16. Divide: 95 ÷ 16 = 545.

items.q: Simplify 1 + 5718 − 12.
items.e: Top: 1 + 57 = 127. Bottom: 18 − 12 = −38. Divide: 127 ÷ −38 = −327.

items.q: Simplify 1 + 4x1 − 16x².
items.e: Multiply the top and bottom by x²: x² + 4xx² − 16. The bottom is a difference of squares: x(x + 4) ÷ ((x + 4)(x − 4)) = xx − 4.

items.q: Simplify 1 + 5713 − 12.
items.e: Top: 1 + 57 = 127. Bottom: 13 − 12 = −16. Divide: 127 ÷ −16 = −727.

items.q: Simplify 1 + 5715 − 12.
items.e: Top: 1 + 57 = 127. Bottom: 15 − 12 = −310. Divide: 127 ÷ −310 = −407.

items.q: Simplify 1 + 1316 − 12.
items.e: Top: 1 + 13 = 43. Bottom: 16 − 12 = −13. Divide: 43 ÷ −13 = −4.
